name: dev-weights-120m-band-edge-lot-roundup
rationale: Cost-side (warning rule; 28th consecutive negative run at 500k), 2026-11-19 lead #1. On 2026-11-19 the dev weights were the only composite with positive gross timing value (+0.77pp zero-cost excess vs static mix at 500k) but lost ~13pp to cost over 771 trades, while every trend-only variant's gain was pure cost reduction on a gross-negative signal. Band-edge + lot round-up sizing at 120m spacing cut 500k fees ~6x on the trend family (28,005 -> 4,416 JPY). This tests whether the same sizing/spacing keeps dev's gross edge while removing most of its cost.
code_change_summary: Port ONLY the order-sizing part of commit 66a11ec (branch experiment/trend-only-subsignals-120m-band-edge-lot-roundup) onto dev: add TradingEngine::band_edge_delta and TradingEngine::band_edge_order (band-edge sizing with lot round-up) and switch the three call-sites (handle_indicator, handle_rebalance, Simulator::run) from allocation_delta_to_order to band_edge_order, plus the matching simulator test update. Leave compute_btc_target and its weights exactly as on dev. Update doc-comment NOTEs to name this hypothesis.
constraints: MUST NOT change TradingEngine::compute_btc_target at all (neither signature nor body): the dev sub-signal weights (REVERSION 1.0 / TREND 0.25) stay exactly as they are on dev. Do NOT cherry-pick 7aa88ce, 510ce0e or dd7a59a (the trend-only weight commits).

This touches the live rebalance path in src/trading/engine.rs (handle_indicator, handle_rebalance). The change MUST be made only on this hypothesis's own dedicated isolation: "worktree" branch -- never as a direct commit to dev/main -- and a promoted PR must flag explicitly that it changes live order sizing.

The sizing change alters only the size of an order that already passes the `delta.abs() >= allocation_threshold` gate; the gate itself and allocation_delta_to_order are unchanged. Live and backtest (Simulator::run) MUST use the same helper.
MUST pass `cargo test`; update expected values of tests whose behaviour legitimately changes (with a comment explaining the arithmetic), never weaken or delete a test just to make it pass.
A promoted change still becomes its own PR against dev and is never merged automatically.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or the auto-updater.
